subject: Azure marketplace intake + field warm-handshake for Contoso referral
messages:
From: Maria Lopez <maria@contoso.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 15 Mar 2025 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Azure marketplace & co-sell support — Partner Center referral for Contoso

Hi Soojin & Vanessa,

Thanks for taking this initial reach-out. Contoso is preparing a marketplace listing for our new security automation offering and we want to explore a Partner Center referral so Microsoft field sellers can help qualify/accelerate opportunities.

Quick context: we have a shortlist of 120 target accounts (attached) in North America that overlap with the Azure field. The listing draft and the account map are attached — we expect procurement timelines starting late May.

Could you share how Redwood typically hands a Partner Center referral to field sellers? We want a low-friction path: clear seller contact, expected next-step SLA, and an initial mutual action plan template. Happy to hop on a call next week.

Attachments: contoso_account_map.csv, marketplace_listing_draft.pdf

Thanks,
Maria Lopez
Head of Cloud Partnerships
Contoso Ltd.
+maria@contoso.com
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Lopez <maria@contoso.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 15 Mar 2025 10:05:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Azure marketplace & co-sell support — Partner Center referral for Contoso

Hi Maria — great to meet you (virtually) and thanks for the attachments.

High level on our side: we run a lightweight intake -> field alignment -> referral submission process for Partner Center that is designed to minimize churn for both ISV and field sellers. Key pieces we typically provide up-front:
- Account overlap map (you already provided — perfect)
- Suggested field seller matches + owner contacts (we create this)
- One-page mutual action plan (MAP) template for the first 30 days
- Targeted contacts at Microsoft (if eligible for co-sell) and a recommended submission cadence

Next steps I propose:
1) Quick internal sync (30m) between Redwood (me, Vanessa, Karthik) to align the seller grid and any eligibility gaps.
2) Joint call with Contoso + our recommended MS seller (15–30m) to introduce and confirm ownership.
3) We submit the Partner Center referral and attach the MAP + listing draft.

Vanessa & Karthik — can you review the attached account map and confirm availability for a Monday internal sync (Mar 17)? I’ll draft the MAP and a one-pager to send to Maria in advance of the joint intro.

I’ll also attach a stub of our marketplace checklist for transparency.

Attachments referenced: seller_match_grid.xlsx (will attach in follow-up), marketplace_process_checklist.pdf

Best,
Soojin Lee
Partner GTM, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Maria Lopez <maria@contoso.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 16 Mar 2025 09:20:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Azure marketplace & co-sell support — Partner Center referral for Contoso

Thanks, Soojin — yes, happy to take point on the seller mapping. Maria — I reviewed the account map and sketched an initial seller-match grid (see attached). High level notes:

- 38 accounts overlap with Microsoft field reps tied to West US and Central regions — we recommend prioritizing those for the first wave.
- 14 accounts are already engaged by existing ISV partners (we flagged those as contested in the attachment).
- 6 accounts have tight procurement windows (May–June); we should push those into the canary referral batch so sellers can prioritize outreach.

Suggested 3-step handoff:
1) Internal mapping — finalize seller owners and update the spreadsheet.
2) Intro email — Redwood introduces Contoso and the lead seller with a short MAP and ask for a 20m discovery.
3) Referral submission — once seller confirms interest, we submit Partner Center referral and mark the opportunity in HubSpot (link below).

I’m attaching seller_match_grid.xlsx and have added seller contact emails for the West US sellers.

Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
Attachments: seller_match_grid.xlsx
Related: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/contoso/companies/9001
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Maria Lopez <maria@contoso.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Mar 2025 13:04:10 -0700
Subject: Re: Azure marketplace & co-sell support — Partner Center referral for Contoso

Thanks Vanessa — the grid looks good. A couple of practical items before we push referrals: 

- Eligibility check: marketplace listing must meet co-sell policy (I’ll run the quick checklist and flag any data residency or telemetry items that might block co-sell).
- Routing policy: when we submit the Partner Center referral we need the seller owner email + confirmation that seller will follow the MAP within 5 business days. If seller doesn’t accept, we fall back to an alternate regional rep.
- Contract milestone: Contoso, please confirm whether you prefer to have a mutual NDA or if the existing MSA covers the initial discovery (I’ve included a DocuSign powerform below for MSA signature if helpful).

DocuSign (MSA powerform): https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abc123

I’ll block 30m tomorrow (Mar 18) for a retailer/West-US seller alignment session — Vanessa, can you bring the final seller_match_grid and I’ll prepare the Partner Center referral template?

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
GTM Ops, Redwood Inference
From: Maria Lopez <maria@contoso.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 Mar 2025 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Azure marketplace & co-sell support — Partner Center referral for Contoso

Appreciate the quick turnaround and clarity. We confirm:
- Contoso prefers to use the existing MSA for initial discovery (no NDA required).
- Can agree to the 5-business-day seller response SLA.
- We’re good to prioritize the six procurement-window accounts for the first canary batch.

We’re available for the alignment session on Tue Mar 18 at 11:00 PT. Please send the calendar invite and any prep materials. After that, we’ll expect the referral to be submitted within ~48 hours if seller confirms.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to the intro.

Maria Lopez
Head of Cloud Partnerships
Contoso Ltd.
Attachments referenced in thread: marketplace_listing_draft.pdf, contoso_account_map.csv
